`timescale 1ns / 1ps

// ============================================================================
// gaussian5x5.v
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Purpose:
//   5x5 Gaussian noise-reduction filter for an 8-bit streaming image.
//
// Input:
//   Five vertically adjacent pixel streams generated by line_buffer.v:
//
//       i_line0 = current image row
//       i_line1 = previous image row
//       i_line2 = row-2
//       i_line3 = row-3
//       i_line4 = row-4
//
// For each row, five horizontal pixels are maintained using shift registers.
//
// Gaussian kernel:
//
//       1   4   6   4   1
//       4  16  24  16   4
//       6  24  36  24   6
//       4  16  24  16   4
//       1   4   6   4   1
//
// Normalization = 256.
//
// Output:
//
//       gaussian_pixel = convolution / 256
//
// Assumptions:
//   - DATA_WIDTH = 8.
//   - One pixel is accepted per clock when i_valid = 1.
//   - Input is raster scanned.
//   - i_line0..i_line4 correspond to the same image column.
//   - Four previous image rows are supplied by line_buffer.v.
//   - Border pixels are suppressed rather than padded.
//
// ============================================================================

module gaussian5x5 #(
    parameter integer DATA_WIDTH = 8
)(
    input  wire                     clk,
    input  wire                     rst,

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Five vertically adjacent pixels
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    i_line0,
    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    i_line1,
    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    i_line2,
    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    i_line3,
    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    i_line4,

    input  wire                     i_valid,
    input  wire                     i_window_valid,

    // End-of-line indication from input stream.
    input  wire                     i_eol,

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Filtered output
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    o_pixel,
    output reg                      o_valid

);

    // =========================================================================
    // Horizontal shift registers
    // =========================================================================
    //
    // Each row maintains five pixels:
    //
    // row0 = x-4 x-3 x-2 x-1 x
    // row1 = x-4 x-3 x-2 x-1 x
    // ...
    //
    // The current pixel enters [4].
    //
    // ========================================================================

    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row0_d0;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row0_d1;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row0_d2;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row0_d3;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row0_d4;

    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row1_d0;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row1_d1;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row1_d2;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row1_d3;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row1_d4;

    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row2_d0;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row2_d1;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row2_d2;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row2_d3;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row2_d4;

    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row3_d0;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row3_d1;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row3_d2;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row3_d3;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row3_d4;

    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row4_d0;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row4_d1;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row4_d2;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row4_d3;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] row4_d4;


    // =========================================================================
    // Intermediate products
    // =========================================================================
    //
    // Maximum possible convolution:
    //
    // 255 * sum(kernel)
    //
    // sum(kernel) = 256
    //
    // Maximum = 65280.
    //
    // Therefore 16 bits are sufficient for the final accumulator.
    //
    // We use 18 bits internally to provide comfortable synthesis margin.
    // =========================================================================

    reg [17:0] sum_stage0;
    reg [17:0] sum_stage1;
    reg [17:0] sum_stage2;
    reg [17:0] sum_stage3;
    reg [17:0] sum_stage4;

    reg [19:0] gaussian_sum;


    // =========================================================================
    // Horizontal shift registers
    // =========================================================================

    always @(posedge clk) begin

        if (rst) begin

            row0_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row0_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row0_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row0_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row0_d4 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};

            row1_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row1_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row1_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row1_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row1_d4 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};

            row2_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row2_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row2_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row2_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row2_d4 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};

            row3_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row3_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row3_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row3_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row3_d4 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};

            row4_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row4_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row4_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row4_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            row4_d4 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};

        end
        else if (i_valid) begin

            // ---------------------------------------------------------------
            // Row 0
            // ---------------------------------------------------------------

            if (i_eol) begin

                row0_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row0_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row0_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row0_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row0_d4 <= i_line0;

                row1_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row1_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row1_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row1_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row1_d4 <= i_line1;

                row2_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row2_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row2_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row2_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row2_d4 <= i_line2;

                row3_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row3_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row3_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row3_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row3_d4 <= i_line3;

                row4_d0 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row4_d1 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row4_d2 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row4_d3 <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                row4_d4 <= i_line4;

            end
            else begin

                row0_d0 <= row0_d1;
                row0_d1 <= row0_d2;
                row0_d2 <= row0_d3;
                row0_d3 <= row0_d4;
                row0_d4 <= i_line0;

                row1_d0 <= row1_d1;
                row1_d1 <= row1_d2;
                row1_d2 <= row1_d3;
                row1_d3 <= row1_d4;
                row1_d4 <= i_line1;

                row2_d0 <= row2_d1;
                row2_d1 <= row2_d2;
                row2_d2 <= row2_d3;
                row2_d3 <= row2_d4;
                row2_d4 <= i_line2;

                row3_d0 <= row3_d1;
                row3_d1 <= row3_d2;
                row3_d2 <= row3_d3;
                row3_d3 <= row3_d4;
                row3_d4 <= i_line3;

                row4_d0 <= row4_d1;
                row4_d1 <= row4_d2;
                row4_d2 <= row4_d3;
                row4_d3 <= row4_d4;
                row4_d4 <= i_line4;

            end
        end
    end


    // =========================================================================
    // Gaussian convolution
    // =========================================================================
    //
    // Instead of using multipliers, all coefficients are powers/small
    // constants. Vivado can implement these efficiently using shifts/adders.
    //
    // For each row:
    //
    // [1 4 6 4 1]
    //
    // x1 + x2*4 + x3*6 + x4*4 + x5
    //
    // =========================================================================

    always @(posedge clk) begin

        if (rst) begin

            sum_stage0 <= 18'd0;
            sum_stage1 <= 18'd0;
            sum_stage2 <= 18'd0;
            sum_stage3 <= 18'd0;
            sum_stage4 <= 18'd0;

        end
        else if (i_valid) begin

            // Row 0
            sum_stage0 <=
                  row0_d0
                + (row0_d1 << 2)
                + (row0_d2 << 2)
                + (row0_d2 << 1)
                + (row0_d3 << 2)
                + row0_d4;

            // Row 1
            sum_stage1 <=
                  (row1_d0 << 2)
                + (row1_d1 << 4)
                + (row1_d2 << 4)
                + (row1_d2 << 3)
                + (row1_d3 << 4)
                + (row1_d4 << 2);

            // Row 2
            sum_stage2 <=
                  (row2_d0 << 2)
                + (row2_d1 << 5)
                + (row2_d2 << 5)
                + (row2_d2 << 2)
                + (row2_d3 << 5)
                + (row2_d4 << 2);

            // Row 3
            sum_stage3 <=
                  (row3_d0 << 2)
                + (row3_d1 << 4)
                + (row3_d2 << 4)
                + (row3_d2 << 3)
                + (row3_d3 << 4)
                + (row3_d4 << 2);

            // Row 4
            sum_stage4 <=
                  row4_d0
                + (row4_d1 << 2)
                + (row4_d2 << 2)
                + (row4_d2 << 1)
                + (row4_d3 << 2)
                + row4_d4;

        end
    end


    // =========================================================================
    // Vertical accumulation and normalization
    // =========================================================================

    always @(posedge clk) begin

        if (rst) begin

            gaussian_sum <= 20'd0;
            o_pixel      <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            o_valid      <= 1'b0;

        end
        else begin

            o_valid <= 1'b0;

            if (i_valid) begin

                gaussian_sum <=
                      sum_stage0
                    + sum_stage1
                    + sum_stage2
                    + sum_stage3
                    + sum_stage4;

                // ------------------------------------------------------------
                // Divide by 256.
                //
                // Since normalization factor is 256 = 2^8:
                //
                //       output = sum >> 8
                //
                // The result is guaranteed to fit within 8 bits for an
                // 8-bit input image.
                // ------------------------------------------------------------

                if (i_window_valid) begin

                    o_pixel <=
                        (
                            sum_stage0
                          + sum_stage1
                          + sum_stage2
                          + sum_stage3
                          + sum_stage4
                        ) >> 8;

                    o_valid <= 1'b1;

                end
                else begin

                    o_pixel <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                    o_valid <= 1'b0;

                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
